# iximiuz-labs_play_shell (Resource)

Exposes a web terminal (shell) on a play machine.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "iximiuz-labs_play_shell" "terminal" {
  play_id = iximiuz-labs_play.example.id
  machine = "docker-01"
  user    = "root"
  access  = "public"
}

output "shell_url" {
  value = iximiuz-labs_play_shell.terminal.url
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `machine` (String) The machine name to expose the shell on.
- `play_id` (String) The play ID to expose the shell on.

### Optional

- `access` (String) Access mode for the shell: `private` or `public`.
- `user` (String) The user to open the shell as.

### Read-Only

- `hostname` (String) The hostname assigned to the exposed shell.
- `id` (String) Server-generated shell ID.
- `url` (String) The full URL of the exposed shell.
